\class ExPseudoMetricSpace \extends UniformSpace { | dist : E -> E -> ExUpperReal | dist-refl {x : E} : dist x x = 0 | dist-symm {x y : E} : dist x y = dist y x | dist-triang {x y z : E} : dist x z <= dist x y + dist y z | dist-uniform {C : Set (Set E)} : isUniform C <-> ∃ (eps : Rat) (0 < eps) ∀ x ∃ (U : C) ∀ {y} ((dist x y).U eps -> U y) | uniform-cover => \lam Cu x => (\case dist-uniform.1 Cu \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, h) => \case h x \with { | inP (U, CU, g) => inP (U, CU, g $ rewrite dist-refl eps>0) } }) | uniform-top => dist-uniform.2 $ inP (1, RatField.zro<ide, \lam x => inP (top, idp, \lam _ => ())) | uniform-refine => \lam Cu e => (\case dist-uniform.1 Cu \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, h) => dist-uniform.2 $ inP (eps, eps>0, \lam x => (\case h x \with { | inP (U, CU, g) => \case e CU \with { | inP (V, DV, U<=V) => inP (V, DV, \lam d => U<=V $ g d) } })) }) | uniform-inter => \lam Cu C'u => (\case dist-uniform.1 Cu, dist-uniform.1 C'u \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, h), inP (eps', eps'>0, h') => dist-uniform.2 $ inP (eps ∧ eps', <_meet-univ eps>0 eps'>0, \lam x => (\case h x, h' x \with { | inP (U, CU, g), inP (U', DU', g') => inP (U ∧ U', inP $ later (U, CU, U', DU', idp), \lam d => (g $ ExUpperReal.U_<= d meet-left, g' $ ExUpperReal.U_<= d meet-right)) })) }) | uniform-star => \lam Cu => (\case dist-uniform.1 Cu \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, h) => inP (\lam U => ∃ (x : E) (U = (\lam y => (dist x y).U (eps * ratio 1 4))), dist-uniform.2 $ inP (eps * ratio 1 4, linarith, \lam x => inP $ later (_, inP (x, idp), \lam d => d)), \lam {_} inP (x, idp) => (\case h x \with { | inP (U, CU, g) => inP (U, CU, \lam {_} inP (y, idp) (w, (s1, s2)) {z} d => g $ ExUpperReal.U_<= (ExUpperReal.<=_+-char dist-triang s1 $ ExUpperReal.<=_+-char dist-triang (rewrite dist-symm in s2) d) linarith) })) }) | isUniform => isUniform | dist-uniform => dist-uniform-impl }
| dist-refl {x : E} : dist x x = 0
| dist-symm {x y : E} : dist x y = dist y x
| dist-triang {x y z : E} : dist x z <= dist x y + dist y z
| dist-uniform {C : Set (Set E)} : isUniform C <-> ∃ (eps : Rat) (0 < eps) ∀ x ∃ (U : C) ∀ {y} ((dist x y).U eps -> U y)
\lemma metricProperUniform : IsProperUniform
\lemma metricUniform {eps : Rat} (eps>0 : 0 < eps) : PreuniformSpace.isUniform (\lam U => ∃ (x : E) (U = (\lam y => (dist x y).U eps)))
\func NFilter (x : E) : SetFilter E
\lemma halving {x y z : E} {a b c : Rat} (d1 : (dist x y).U a) (d2 : (dist y z).U b) (p : a + b <= c) : (dist x z).U c
\lemma halving-left {x y z : E} {a b c : Rat} (d1 : (dist y x).U a) (d2 : (dist y z).U b) (p : a + b <= c) : (dist x z).U c
\lemma halving-right {x y z : E} {a b c : Rat} (d1 : (dist x y).U a) (d2 : (dist z y).U b) (p : a + b <= c) : (dist x z).U c

\class PseudoMetricSpace \extends ExPseudoMetricSpace, StronglyRegularUniformSpace { \override dist : E -> E -> Real | uniform-strongly-star => \lam Cu => (\case dist-uniform.1 Cu \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, h) => inP (\lam U => ∃ (x : E) (U = (\lam y => (dist x y).U (eps * ratio 1 8))), dist-uniform.2 $ inP (eps * ratio 1 8, linarith, \lam x => inP $ later (_, inP (x, idp), \lam d => d)), \lam {_} inP (x, idp) => (\case h x \with { | inP (U, CU, g) => inP (U, CU, \lam {_} inP (y, idp) => (\case RealAbGroup.<-comparison (dist x y) {eps * ratio 1 4} {eps * ratio 1 2} (rat_real_<.1 linarith) \with { | byLeft xy>eps/4 => byLeft (\lam (z, (xz<eps/8, yz<eps/8)) => <-irreflexive $ xy>eps/4 <∘ real_<_U.2 (halving-right xz<eps/8 yz<eps/8 linarith)) | byRight xy<eps/2 => byRight (\lam {z} yz<eps/8 => g $ halving (real_<_U.1 xy<eps/2) yz<eps/8 linarith) })) })) }) }
\func IsDistBounded : \Prop
\lemma dist>=0 {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {x y : X} : 0 <= dist x y
\func OBall {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} (eps : Rat) (x : X) : Set X
\lemma OBall-center {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {eps : Rat} (eps>0 : 0 < eps) {x : X} : OBall eps x x
\lemma OBall-open {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {eps : Rat} {x : X} : isOpen (OBall eps x)
\lemma OBall-center_<=< {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {eps : Rat} (eps>0 : 0 < eps) {x : X} : single x <=< OBall eps x
\lemma cauchy-ball {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {C : Set (Set X)} (Cc : isCauchy C) (x : X) : ∃ (eps : Rat) (0 < eps) (U : C) (OBall eps x ⊆ U)
\lemma dist_open {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {U : Set X} : isOpen U <-> ∀ {x : U} ∃ (eps : Rat) (0 < eps) (OBall eps x ⊆ U)
\lemma <=<-ball {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {x : X} {U : Set X} (x<=<U : single x <=< U) : ∃ (eps : Rat) (0 < eps) (OBall eps x ⊆ U)
\lemma OBall_<=* {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {x : X} {eps delta : Rat} (delta<eps : delta < eps) : OBall delta x <=* OBall eps x
\lemma OBall_<=< {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {x : X} {eps delta : Rat} (delta<eps : delta < eps) : OBall delta x <=< OBall eps x
\lemma OBall_s<=* {X : PseudoMetricSpace} {x : X} {eps delta : Rat} (delta<eps : delta < eps) : OBall delta x s<=* OBall eps x
\func ldist {X : PseudoMetricSpace} (x y : X) : Real
\lemma ldist>=0 {X : PseudoMetricSpace} {x y : X} : 0 <= X.dist x y
\lemma ldist-refl {X : PseudoMetricSpace} {x : X} : ldist x x = 0
\lemma ldist-symm {X : PseudoMetricSpace} {x y : X} : ldist x y = ldist y x
\lemma ldist-triang {X : PseudoMetricSpace} {x y z : X} : ldist x z <= ldist x y + ldist y z

\lemma metric-contAt-char {X Y : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {f : X -> Y} {x : X} : IsContAt f x <-> ∀ {eps : Rat} (0 < eps) ∃ (delta : Rat) (0 < delta) ∀ {x'} ((dist x x').U delta -> (dist (f x) (f x')).U eps)

\lemma metric-contAt-real {X Y : PseudoMetricSpace} {f : X -> Y} {x : X} : IsContAt f x <-> ∀ {eps : Real} (0 < eps) ∃ (delta : Real) (0 < delta) ∀ {x'} (X.dist x x' < delta -> Y.dist (f x) (f x') < eps)

\class ExMetricSpace \extends ExPseudoMetricSpace, SeparatedCoverSpace { | dist-ext {x y : E} : dist x y = 0 -> x = y | isSeparatedCoverSpace => \lam f => dist-ext $ <=-antisymmetric (\lam b>0 => (\case f $ makeCauchy $ metricUniform (half>0 b>0) \with { | inP (_, inP (z, idp), (zx<b/2, zy<b/2)) => halving1/2 zx<b/2 zy<b/2 })) dist>=0 | dist-ext => \lam p => isSeparatedCoverSpace $ SeparatedCoverSpace.separated-char 4 7 (\lam x<=<U => (\case <=<-ball x<=<U \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, q) => q $ transportInv (ExUpperReal.U {__} eps) p eps>0 })) }
\lemma metric-ext {X : ExMetricSpace} {x y : X} (p : \Pi {eps : Rat} -> 0 < eps -> (dist x y).U eps) : x = y
\class MetricSpace \extends PseudoMetricSpace, ExMetricSpace
\class CompleteMetricSpace \extends MetricSpace, StronglyCompleteUniformSpace

\class CompleteExMetricSpace \extends ExMetricSpace, CompleteUniformSpace { | isCompleteMetric (F : ProperFilter E) : ∀ {eps} (0 < eps) ∃ (x : E) (F (OBall eps x)) -> ∃ (x : E) ∀ {eps} (0 < eps) (F (OBall eps x)) | isComplete => \lam F => (\case isCompleteMetric F (cauchyFilter-metric-char.1 F.isCauchyFilter) \with { | inP (x, h) => inP (x, \lam {U} x<=<U => (\case <=<-ball x<=<U \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, Up) => filter-mono (h eps>0) Up })) }) | isCompleteMetric => \lam F Fc => (\have F' => \new (CauchyFilter \this) { | ProperFilter => F | isCauchyFilter => cauchyFilter-metric-char.2 Fc } \in \case isComplete (regCF F') \with { | inP (x, xF) => inP (x, \lam eps>0 => regCF_<= {_} {F'} $ xF $ OBall-center_<=< eps>0) }) }
\lemma cauchyFilter-metric-char {X : ExPseudoMetricSpace} {F : SetFilter X} : IsCauchyFilter F <-> ∀ {eps} (0 < eps) ∃ (x : X) (F (OBall eps x))

\record LocallyUniformMetricMap \extends LocallyUniformMap { \override Dom : ExPseudoMetricSpace \override Cod : ExPseudoMetricSpace | func-dist-locally-uniform : ∀ {eps : Rat} (0 < eps) ∃ (delta : Rat) (0 < delta) ∀ (x0 : Dom) ∃ (gamma : Rat) (0 < gamma) ∀ {x x' : Dom} ((dist x0 x).U delta -> (dist x x').U gamma -> (dist (func x) (func x')).U eps) | func-locally-uniform => \lam Eu => (\case dist-uniform.1 Eu \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, h) => \case func-dist-locally-uniform eps>0 \with { | inP (delta, delta>0, g) => inP (_, metricUniform delta>0, \lam inP (x0, p) => (\case g x0 \with { | inP (gamma, gamma>0, g') => dist-uniform.2 $ inP (gamma, gamma>0, \lam x => (\case h (func x) \with { | inP (W, EW, e) => inP (\lam x' => (dist x x').U gamma, inP $ later (W, EW, \lam {x'} c => e $ rewrite (dist-symm {Cod}) $ g' (rewrite p in c.1) $ rewrite (dist-symm {Dom}) c.2), \lam d => d) })) })) } }) }

\record UniformMetricMap \extends LocallyUniformMetricMap, UniformMap { \override Dom : ExPseudoMetricSpace \override Cod : ExPseudoMetricSpace | func-dist-uniform : ∀ {eps : Rat} (0 < eps) ∃ (delta : Rat) (0 < delta) ∀ {x x' : Dom} ((dist x x').U delta -> (dist (func x) (func x')).U eps) | func-dist-locally-uniform => \lam eps>0 => (\case func-dist-uniform eps>0 \with { | inP (delta, delta>0, h) => inP (delta, delta>0, \lam x0 => inP (delta, delta>0, \lam _ => h)) }) | func-uniform => \lam Eu => (\case dist-uniform.1 Eu \with { | inP (eps, eps>0, h) => \case func-dist-uniform eps>0 \with { | inP (delta, delta>0, g) => dist-uniform.2 $ inP (delta, delta>0, \lam x => (\case h (func x) \with { | inP (U, EU, e) => inP (_, inP $ later (U, EU, idp), \lam d => e (g d)) })) } }) }

\record MetricMap \extends UniformMetricMap { | func-dist {x y : Dom} : dist (func x) (func y) <= dist x y | func-dist-uniform => \lam {eps} eps>0 => inP (eps, eps>0, func-dist __) | func-cont => \lam {U} => defaultImpl PrecoverMap func-cont {_} {U} }
\lemma func-ldist {X Y : PseudoMetricSpace} {f : MetricMap X Y} {x x' : X} : Y.dist (f x) (f x') <= X.dist x x'
\record IsometricMap \extends MetricMap { | func-isometry {x y : Dom} : dist (func x) (func y) = dist x y | func-dist => =_<= func-isometry }
\lemma dense->uniformEmbedding (d : IsDense) : UniformMap.IsDenseUniformEmbedding
\lemma func-lisometry {X Y : PseudoMetricSpace} {f : IsometricMap X Y} {x x' : X} : Y.dist (f x) (f x') = X.dist x x'
